card.name: Years and journal names in citations
card.fires_on: The last digit of a year, or the final letter of PLoS, inside a journal reference. It appears in citation lines after a journal name, such as PLoS Med or Ann Oncol, just before volume and page numbers or a DOI.

modes.label: Final digit of year
modes.description: The last digit of a publication year (2000s to 2010s) in a reference entry.

modes.label: PLoS journal name
modes.description: The S in PLoS, or the med in a PLoS DOI, in a reference to a PLoS journal.
